difficulty_reason: The author compares two distinct first-order interpretations of SOGAT signatures by using Yoneda as a CwF pseudomorphism and a simultaneous structural induction on contexts, substitutions, types and terms. The non-routine step transports dependent type interpretation across two presheaf levels while preserving the locally representable universe and extracting the closed-signature model isomorphism. The complete printed proof and explicit constructions defining both interpretations are retained; H3 is not asserted.
core_obligations: Retain ToS and ToS+ type-former definitions and the first-order CwF conventions.
Retain the presheaf, locally representable type, and direct presheaf model constructions actually used by Theorem22.
Retain the complete author simultaneous-induction proof, its four alpha components and final closed-signature isomorphism; do not supplement the printed induction.
